name: The Second Troll Legend
summary: The Second Troll Legend lies on a tablet in the drowned ruins of Vile Reef, off Stranglethorn Vale. Brother Nimetz seeks its markings as part of his inquiry into Colonel Kurzen’s fall.

sections.title: Gri’lek the Wanderer
sections.body: Far beneath the water at Vile Reef, the Second Troll Legend marks one of the ruins’ stone tablets. Its name is Gri’lek the Wanderer. Brother Nimetz asks for its markings alongside three other troll legends, hoping they may shed light on Colonel Kurzen’s corruption.

faq.q: Where is the Second Troll Legend?
faq.answer: The Second Troll Legend is on a tablet called Gri’lek the Wanderer in the drowned ruins of Vile Reef, off Stranglethorn Vale.
Brother Nimetz at Rebel Camp seeks the Second Troll Legend and three other tablet inscriptions for his inquiry into Colonel Kurzen.

faq.q: Why is Brother Nimetz collecting troll legends?
faq.answer: Brother Nimetz hopes the troll legends will help explain what caused Colonel Kurzen’s fall into depravity.
Gri’lek the Wanderer is the stone tablet that bears the Second Troll Legend in Vile Reef.

angles.text: Brother Nimetz, an Alliance scholar at Rebel Camp, seeks these inscriptions to investigate Colonel Kurzen’s corruption.
